orders.title: Orders
orders.lead: Search orders by status, the days they were placed, seller, buyer or number; read one, and complete a delivered one early.
orders.filters.title: Search orders
orders.filters.rangeNote: Days in your time zone, {zone}; the last day is included.
orders.filters.rangeInverted: The first day comes after the last.
orders.filters.principalInvalid: A principal id is a UUID of 36 characters, such as a3d5f7b9-2c4e-4a6b-8d0f-1e3a5c7b9d21.
orders.filters.orderNumberNote: The whole number, such as ORD-20261022-7F3A9C1B.
orders.results.title: Results
orders.results.caption: Orders found, newest first
orders.failure.status: Order does not know one of the statuses asked for.
orders.failure.range: Order refused the days: the first day must not come after the last.
orders.failure.cursor: This page of results can no longer be read. Start again from the newest.
orders.failure.merchant: Order refused the seller principal: it takes a principal id, a UUID of 36 characters.
orders.failure.customer: Order refused the buyer principal: it takes a principal id, a UUID of 36 characters.
orders.failure.orderNumber: Order refused the order number: it takes one whole number, exactly as issued.
orders.failure.admin: Order answered that this account is not an admin.
orders.failure.unknown: The search could not be read.
orders.idle.title: No order chosen
orders.idle.body: Choose an order from the results to read it. Order writes every read of an order to its audit log.
orders.detail.missing: Order has no order with this id.
orders.items.title: Items
orders.shipping.title: Shipping
orders.basis.DISTANCE_QUOTED: By matching, for the route and the parcel's weight
orders.basis.TIER_FLOOR: At the service's floor, without a route
orders.basis.CLIENT_SUPPLIED: As the buyer's app sent it, before order asked matching
orders.timeline.title: Timeline
orders.timeline.note: The times order's answers carry. Order keeps every step in its lifecycle log, which no endpoint serves yet.
orders.timeline.partial: Only the time it was placed: the delivery and completion times come with the order in the search results.
orders.return.title: Return
orders.return.loading: Reading the returns that need attention…
orders.return.none: No return against this order waits on staff. Order lists only those that do.
orders.return.unreadable: The returns that need attention could not be read, so a return against this order cannot be shown.
orders.complete.title: Complete early
orders.complete.body: A delivered order completes when its return window closes, and the merchant is paid then. Completing it now pays the merchant at once.
orders.complete.blocked: Return {number} against this order is not resolved, so it cannot be completed yet.
orders.complete.notDelivered: Only a delivered order can be completed early.
orders.complete.confirmBody: The merchant is paid now instead of when the return window closes, and the buyer can no longer open a return. This cannot be undone.
orders.complete.released: {number} is completed, and payment released the escrow to the merchant.
orders.complete.retried: {number} is completed. Payment could not be reached to release the escrow; order keeps asking until payment accepts.
orders.complete.awaitsStaff: {number} is completed, but payment refused to release the escrow. It is not retried and waits for staff to settle it with payment.
orders.complete.notReleased: {number} is completed, but payment did not release the escrow at once: {detail}
orders.complete.failure.notFound: Order has no order with this number. The results are read again.
orders.complete.failure.already: The order is already completed, by its return window or another admin. Nothing changed.
orders.complete.failure.alreadyAfterRetr: The order is completed: the attempt whose answer was lost went through, or another admin completed it. Nothing more changed.
orders.complete.failure.returnUnresolved: A return against this order is not resolved, so the buyer may still be owed a refund. Resolve it first; an open one can be rejected on the returns screen.
orders.complete.failure.notDelivered: The order is not delivered, so it cannot be completed. It is read again.
orders.complete.failure.admin: Order answered that this account is not an admin.
orders.complete.failure.uncertain: Whether the order was completed is not known. Sending it again is safe: if the first attempt went through, order answers that it is already complete.
orders.keys.label: Keys on this page
sagas.title: Stuck checkouts
sagas.lead: Checkout sagas that could not unwind on their own. Each step still held names the call that gives it back; nothing on this page changes them.
sagas.list.title: Sagas
sagas.list.empty: No checkout waits on a person.
sagas.list.limit: Order lists the {shown} most recently flagged; it counts {total}.
sagas.filter.label: Filter sagas
sagas.filter.description: Order number, saga id or failure code
sagas.idle.title: No saga chosen
sagas.idle.body: Choose a saga to see the steps it still holds and how each is given back.
sagas.missing.title: Not listed
sagas.missing.body: This saga is not among those needing attention any more.
sagas.detail.lead: Order still retries this saga on its own; the steps below are what it has not given back yet.
sagas.detail.abandonedLead: Order no longer retries this saga. The steps below stay held until someone gives them back by hand.
sagas.detail.noOrder: Order has no row for it
sagas.steps.title: Steps still held
sagas.steps.note: Order names the call that gives each step back. It is made by hand, outside the backoffice.
sagas.steps.empty: Order lists no step for this saga.
returns.title: Returns needing attention
returns.lead: Returns still open, and returns whose goods came back but whose refund stopped. An open one whose goods never came back can be rejected here.
returns.list.title: Returns
returns.filter.label: Filter returns
returns.idle.title: No return chosen
returns.idle.body: Choose a return to read it and, if it is open, to reject it.
returns.missing.title: Not listed
returns.missing.body: Return {number} is not among those needing attention: it may have been decided already.
returns.detail.openLead: Open, with no goods back. While it is open the order cannot complete and the merchant is not paid; it does not lapse on its own.
returns.detail.stuckLead: The goods came back and the buyer is owed {amount}, but the refund stopped and is not retried on its own.
returns.detail.goneLead: No longer among the returns needing attention: it was decided while you looked, by another admin or an earlier attempt.
returns.reject.body: Rejecting gives the buyer no refund. The order then completes when its return window closes, or earlier if an admin completes it.
returns.reject.notOffered: The goods came back, so the buyer is owed a refund and the return cannot be rejected. Settle the refund with payment.
returns.reject.gone: Nothing to do here any more.
returns.reject.title: Reject {number}?
returns.reject.confirmBody: The buyer gets no refund, and the merchant is paid when the order completes. This cannot be undone.
returns.reject.reasonNote: Kept with the return. {left} characters left; order keeps the first 500.
returns.reject.reasonRequired: Say why the return is rejected.
returns.reject.done: {number} is rejected. Order {order} completes when its return window closes.
returns.failure.reasonRequired: Order needs a reason to reject a return.
returns.failure.notFound: Order has no return with this number. The list is read again.
returns.failure.alreadyRejected: This return was already rejected, by another admin. Nothing changed; the list is read again.
returns.failure.alreadyAfterRetry: The return is rejected: the attempt whose answer was lost went through, or another admin rejected it. Nothing more changed.
returns.failure.goodsReceived: The goods came back, so the buyer is owed a refund and the return cannot be rejected. The list is read again.
returns.failure.admin: Order answered that this account is not an admin.
returns.failure.uncertain: Whether the return was rejected is not known. Sending it again is safe: if the first attempt went through, order answers that it was already rejected.
